运维任务审批ID。

description.en:
The approval ID of the O&M task.
> You can call the ListTodoOpsTaskApprovals operation to query this parameter.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
